rubrics.date: Missale Romanum 1962, proper of the Saints at 31 May: after the Mass of the Queenship of the Blessed Virgin Mary, the three orations Pro S. Petronilla (Benziger printed pp. 543–544, Vatican printed pp. 540–541), and the same day marked as the commemoration of St Petronilla, Virgin (Benziger p. 544, Vatican p. 541). It is fixed to that day and is not transferred.
rubrics.scope: Observed in the Mass of the day by her three orations alone; her own Mass Vultum tuum (Common of Virgins) is not selected by this edition.
rubrics.rank: Rubricae generales 106–109: an ordinary commemoration, made in every low Mass and in a sung conventual Mass, and omitted in a sung Mass that is not conventual (108).
rubrics.admission: Rubricae generales 111 and 434: a second-class day admits one commemoration, a second-class Sunday only a second-class feast, a first-class day only a privileged commemoration; 113–114: a de Tempore commemoration comes first and the excess is omitted, so the impeded Vigil of the Ascension (31–33) takes the single place when it falls on 31 May; 30: none on the Vigil of Pentecost.
rubrics.conclusion: Rubricae generales 436–437: each commemoration oration follows the corresponding Mass oration under its own, separate conclusion; 480–481: only the last Secret's terminal is audible.
